content.title: Jamal Murray's 30 Points Give Nuggets Win in Game 1 | DNVR Nuggets Postgame Live
content.text: Welcome to the playoffs. The Denver Nuggets WIN game 1 against the Anthony Edwards and the Minnesota Timberwolves. Despite a crazy cold shooting start and a physical battle the whole game. The Nuggets went on a run in the 3rd quarter to push to a big lead and were able to hold on to the end of the game. Jokic started slow scoring but Jamal Murray had a vintage flurry and carried the scoring load when Jokic was getting going. The bench had some big minutes and the Nuggets take game 1 at home to take a 1-0 lead in the series.
